title: Move `master` branch to `main`
description:
The `master` branch of this repository will soon be renamed to `main`, as part of a coordinated change across several GitHub organizations (including, but not limited to: [tidyverse](https://github.com/tidyverse), [r-lib](https://github.com/r-lib), [tidymodels](https://github.com/tidymodels), and [sol-eng](https://github.com/sol-eng)). We anticipate this will happen by the end of September 2021.

That will be preceded by a release of the [usethis package](https://usethis.r-lib.org), which will gain some functionality around detecting and adapting to a renamed default branch. There will also be a blog post at the time of this `master` --> `main` change.

The purpose of this issue is to:

* Help us firm up the list of targetted repositories
* Make sure all maintainers are aware of what's coming
* Give us an issue to close when the job is done
* Give us a place to put advice for collaborators re: how to adapt

*message id: euphoric_snowdog*

title: Crash in R with strict write barrier
description:
callr crashes when R is compiled with a strict write barrier. You should be able to reproduce this with [r-debug](https://github.com/wch/r-debug). I ran something like the following.

```r
> docker run --security-opt=seccomp:unconfined -it wch1/r-debug:latest /bin/bash
> RDstrictbarrier -e 'install.packages("callr"); library(callr); r(function() var(iris[, 1:4]))'
```

The interesting bit of the backtrace seems to be pointing to cleancall, which is why I opened this here and not in callr.

```
#29 0x00007ffff789b01b in CHK (x=0x555557b2ea90) at memory.c:174
#30 0x00007ffff78b249f in CAR0 (e=0x5555585b6b80) at memory.c:4117
#31 0x00007fffeffe2953 in call_exits (data=0x7ffffffc6f00) at cleancall.c:104
#32 0x00007ffff77e4698 in R_ExecWithCleanup (fun=0x7fffeffe29b4 <with_cleanup_context_wrap>, data=0x7ffffffc6f00, cleanfun=0x7fffeffe28cc <call_exits>, cleandata=0x7ffffffc6f00) at context.c:884
#33 0x00007fffeffe2a9d in r_with_cleanup_context (fn=0x7fffeffe2739 <eval_wrap>, data=0x7ffffffc6f60) at cleancall.c:132
#34 0x00007fffeffe27d0 in cleancall_call (args=0x5555585b6d40, env=0x5555585b3a20) at cleancall.c:57
```
